interfaces.prefix: Strict growth gives |a^P| >= g+1; all marks except rho0 fix a, and marks at least two also fix b=a^rho0.
interfaces.actual_group: The natural G0=Alt(Omega minus {a}) and evenness make G0 the actual a-stabilizer in G=Alt(Omega). Full ambient IP gives (P1)_a=<rho1>.
interfaces.literal_hypothesis: The theorem assumes exactly two nontrivial H orbits and fixed points exactly a,b in Y. No pending budget theorem or paired-edge hypothesis enters.

new_statements: A small intransitive singleton prefix cannot have precisely two moving H orbits and precisely a,b as H-fixed points.
In the sole support-invariance residual, the actual first prefix is S3; its orbits of size two and six identify an invariant exterior set.
contributions: Acquired strict prefix growth and the natural singleton stabilizer retain their original attribution. The support-invariance split and actual order-six orbit separation are this continuation.
